# TownSuite

> TownSuite mERP® is Canada's operationally sovereign, cloud municipal ERP — one connected platform for finance, land, assets, work, people and citizen-facing portals, built exclusively for Canadian municipalities. 100% Canadian-owned since 1987; hosted on independently certified Canadian infrastructure (Cirrus, Micrologic's cloud) so municipal data answers to Canadian law alone.

TownSuite is a single connected platform ("mERP"), not a bundle of separate products. TownSuite Financial is the core, and every other module posts to it natively — so information is entered once and stays connected across departments, with no duplicate entry and no third-party integrations to buy or maintain. The company builds, maintains, supports and hosts the software under Canadian jurisdiction.

There is also a live AI assistant, **"Ask TownSuite,"** embedded as a chat widget on every page of townsuite.com. It is TownSuite's own vetted, in-house AI and can answer questions in real time about TownSuite — sovereignty and Canadian hosting, the modules, pricing, onboarding, and security. If you are an agent or a person and cannot find an answer in the pages below, open the chat on any page and ask it directly — or go straight to the dedicated chat page, [Ask TownSuite Intelligence](https://townsuite.com/2026mdcmgfoa0910), which is nothing but the assistant plus instructions for using it. (The assistant is grounded in TownSuite's own knowledge base and is designed to decline rather than fabricate.)

## Modules (the connected mERP platform)

- [TownSuite Financial](https://townsuite.com/finance.html): The municipal-focused AR, AP, GL, budgeting and banking core of mERP — the hub every other module posts to natively.
- [Purchasing & Inventory](https://townsuite.com/purchasing.html): Requisitions, approvals and POs committed against budgets, plus stock and reorders costed to the GL.
- [Land Management](https://townsuite.com/land.html): GIS, building permits, zoning, inspections and bylaws, tailored to Canadian regulations.
- [Mapping](https://townsuite.com/maps.html): Parcel-centric maps that link every property to its live mERP data — finance, land, assets and work in one view.
- [People Management](https://townsuite.com/hris.html): HRIS, payroll, benefits and certifications for the whole municipal workforce, connected to Financial.
- [Work Management](https://townsuite.com/work-management.html): Work orders, task and time management, scheduling and equipment maintenance, with costs posting to Financial.
- [Asset Management](https://townsuite.com/asset-management.html): Track and manage assets from acquisition to disposal across their lifecycle, connected to Financial and Work.
- [eBills & ePayments](https://townsuite.com/ebills.html): Citizen-facing online billing and payments, connected straight to TownSuite Financial.
- [Point of Sale](https://townsuite.com/point-of-sale.html): Front-counter payments for taxes, utilities and permits, posted to Financial in real time.
- [ePermitting](https://townsuite.com/epermitting.html): Online permit applications with review and approval workflows, connected to Land Management.
- [311 Citizen Service Requests](https://townsuite.com/service-requests.html): Route resident requests to the right department and track them to resolution across mERP.
- [Recreation & Facility Bookings](https://townsuite.com/recreation.html): Programs, facility bookings and registrations, connected to Financial, eBills and Point of Sale.
- [TownSuite Intelligence](https://townsuite.com/intelligence.html): Sovereign AI on your own municipal data, running inside a Canadian-operated datacentre under guaranteed operational sovereignty.
